title: Moonlight Sculptor 02 · An Impossible Number
description: A strange phone call. A number too large to believe. Follow Lee Hyun from disbelief to a new hope for his family. Book 1, Chapter 1 — second installment. Updated edition with a visible handheld phone during the call.
sources: Personal simplified Mandarin adaptation of NAM Heesung, The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor, Book 1, Chapter 1, Birth of a Dark Gamer. User-supplied first-compilation EPUB, OEBPS/Text/LMS_B01_Chapter_01.xhtml. Continues after the auction listing: online skepticism and verification, rising bids, CTS Media purchase, phone call after a day of work, disbelief, website check, next-day bank confirmation, and sharing the bankbook with Grandmother. Stops before the house move and hospital treatment.

Not an official translation. Brief auction montage compresses the online bidding and company competition. The caller is CTS Media president’s secretary Yoon Nahee, reported as a telephone voice; she is not physically in Hyun’s room. Grandmother is shown in close framing during her bedside conversation. Choices add inner reactions and connective dialogue, without changing the sale, price, hanging up, confirmation or family outcome. No cross-episode choice memory is claimed.
Home background: generated illustration, 2026-10-13, exec-37450174-fab7-488b-9a47-3a2ca1d0799f.png; imagined staging, not an official illustration.
Staging revision: Grandmother is visible for every direct line, with close framing at her bedside. The SVG rig does not depict a lying pose. Dialogue, choices, audio and story outcomes are unchanged.
